clue.text: Shires financed unfairly, put beyond the possibility of democratic participation

definitions.text: put beyond the possibility of democratic participation

indicators.note: something done unfairly is done crookedly, so the letters of these two words are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: County money has been handed out unjustly, shutting people out of democracy.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip someone of the right to vote is to exclude them from democratic participation, exactly what the long definition describes.

clue.text: Pretty girl, embracing one Latvian worker, is like an amateur

indicators.note: the pretty girl hugs the other pieces inside her

parts.note: a dish is slang for an attractive person
I is the Roman numeral one
a Lett is a Latvian
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: An attractive girl hugging a Latvian labourer behaves like a dabbler.
explanation.definitionFit: A dabbler in the arts, not a serious professional, behaves in this amateurish, superficial way.

clue.text: Thus floor a perverted person

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus, used to flag a quoted error
to floor someone is to knock them out, KO

explanation.surface: So knock down a deviant.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal slang for a sick or perverted individual.

clue.text: Worms army chaps pulled up — poetic things

indicators.note: in a down entry, pulled up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army
chaps are men
odes are poems

explanation.surface: Soldiers hauling worms out, accompanied by verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Roundworms are a phylum of slender, unsegmented worms, many parasitic.

clue.text: What could make one brighter, with suffering finally gone?

definitions.text: What could make one brighter, with suffering finally gone?

indicators.note: the word brighter is seen as a rearrangement of the answer with one extra letter
the closing letter of suffering is gone from that rearranged word
finally picks the last letter of suffering

explanation.surface: Asks what might cheer someone up once their pain is over.
explanation.walkthrough: BRIGHTER is a rearrangement of the answer plus G, the last letter of 'suffering'. A fresh start after suffering also brightens one's life.
explanation.definitionFit: Being born again, spiritually renewed, is a new start that would leave one happier once pain has ended.

clue.text: Grandma around one beginning to rest, very blissful state

indicators.note: the grandma word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: nana is a word for grandma
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the beginning of rest is its first letter

explanation.surface: Granny resting is in total bliss.
explanation.definitionFit: In Buddhism it is the transcendent state of perfect peace and happiness.

clue.text: Flirt greeting the fashionistas!

parts.note: hi is a greeting
the ton is fashionable society, from French bon ton

explanation.surface: A cheery chat-up line to the fashion crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: To make advances to someone is to flirt with them, so the phrasal verb is a synonym.

clue.text: Seen to be dotty, having whiff, getting old

indicators.note: dotty means crazy, so these letters go mad and rearrange

parts.note: a whiff is a scent

explanation.surface: Someone going senile, seen to be smelly and odd.
explanation.definitionFit: The formal adjective for an ageing person or organism deteriorating with age.

clue.text: Deputy officer in charge like Scottish chimney sweep

indicators.note: the officer goes in the way a chimney sweep would, so this signals putting one piece inside the other
a chimney sweep works inside the flue, which pictures the officer placed within the chimney

parts.note: lum is the Scots word for a chimney
OC is the standard military abbreviation for officer commanding or in charge

explanation.surface: A stand-in official is compared to a Scottish sweep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'like ... sweep' tells you the officer goes into the Scottish chimney as a sweep would. A LUM is a chimney in Scots dialect.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in doctor or cleric covering temporarily is a deputy for the regular post-holder.

clue.text: Rogue captured by person pulling up

indicators.note: the rogue is taken prisoner inside the person, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a being is a living creature or person
a rat is a scoundrel or rogue

explanation.surface: A villain is caught by someone pulling up in a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pulling up' reads as stopping a vehicle, but here it means telling someone off.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull someone up is to reprimand them, and scolding harshly is a synonym.

clue.text: "The thin form I have!", said lingerie model

indicators.note: the phrase is spoken aloud, giving the name

parts.note: the class I have is my form, a thin one is lean: my lean class

explanation.surface: A lingerie model boasts about her slim figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form' means a school class, not a figure. The answer is a British singer and TV presenter who modelled lingerie for Marks & Spencer.
explanation.definitionFit: This pop singer and presenter fronted a well-known underwear advertising campaign for a British retailer.

clue.text: The baddy — not he who operated as market trader?

indicators.note: not he means the letters of the little word he are left out of what comes before

parts.note: a rotter is a nasty person, a baddy

explanation.surface: A query whether the villain was someone else, the man who ran a market stall.
explanation.walkthrough: Del Boy Trotter is the wheeler-dealing market trader of the British sitcom Only Fools and Horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Del Boy, surnamed this, famously sold dodgy goods from a market stall in the TV comedy.

clue.text: Little woman should keep home — pardon?

indicators.note: the woman holds the home within her, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: Amy is one of the March sisters in Little Women
a nest is a home

explanation.surface: A sexist suggestion that the little woman should stay home, met with 'pardon?'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Little woman' looks like a patronising phrase, but it points to Amy from Alcott's novel Little Women.
explanation.definitionFit: A general pardon granted to offenders by a government is a synonym for that official forgiveness.

clue.text: Cold? It's good to wear a hat

indicators.note: the good letter puts on a hat, so the hat goes round it

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat

explanation.surface: Feeling chilly? Wearing a hat is a good idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A rare, formal adjective meaning chilly or cold, from Latin algidus.

clue.text: Lad is struggling with song that has rapid succession of notes

indicators.note: the letters struggle and twist into a new order

explanation.surface: A boy battling through a song with a fast run.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, a slide sweeping rapidly up or down a scale.

clue.text: Item of armour wasn't disturbed, we hear

indicators.note: the words are spoken, so the sound of the phrase gives the spelling

parts.note: someone left undisturbed had peace

explanation.surface: A piece of armour that lay untouched, so we are told.
explanation.definitionFit: A helmet is a piece of armour worn on the head, which this word names.

clue.text: An Asian nurse in simple summer head covering

indicators.note: these pieces go inside the simple word

parts.note: pat means glib or oversimple, as in a pat answer
an amah is a nursemaid in East or South Asia

explanation.surface: A nurse from Asia wearing a plain sunhat.
explanation.definitionFit: A lightweight straw hat worn in hot weather, a classic summer hat.

clue.text: Heavenly pair work ship with two propellers

parts.note: the Twins are Gemini, the pair in the heavens
to crew a ship is to work it

explanation.surface: Celestial twins sail a vessel with two propellers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ship' looks part of the definition but belongs to the verb phrase 'work ship'.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel with two screw propellers is described with this compound adjective.

clue.text: Constituency boundaries will be — bloody harsh on Corbyn, ultimately?

parts.note: red is the colour of blood
raw weather is harsh

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of the name

explanation.surface: Boundary changes are a cruel blow to Labour's leader.
explanation.walkthrough: Jeremy Corbyn was leader of the UK Labour Party, whose seats were threatened by a boundary review.
explanation.definitionFit: Electoral borders are drawn again in a review, so the definition fills in this completed sentence.

clue.text: Fish in passage you and I must catch

indicators.note: the pair holds the passage within

parts.note: you and I is we
an alley is a narrow passage

explanation.surface: We must catch a fish in an alleyway.
explanation.definitionFit: A North American freshwater perch with large glassy eyes, prized as a game species.

clue.text: 12 — time held to be impracticable

indicators.note: the time letter is gripped inside the midday word

parts.note: twelve o'clock in the day is noon

explanation.surface: An amnesty whose timing is unworkable.
explanation.walkthrough: '12' looks like a cross-reference to 12 across, but it is simply the number twelve, the hour of midday.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unacceptable or unfeasible is described with this informal phrase, so impracticable fits.

clue.text: Delay with our lot trapped in shed

indicators.note: the group is caught inside the other word

parts.note: to shed money is to spend it
our lot is us

explanation.surface: We are delayed, stuck inside a garden shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' is a verb here, getting rid of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To put off or postpone something is to hold it back temporarily, a synonym of delay.

clue.text: Wicked folk losing head and what they are capable of

indicators.note: the first letter is dropped from the wicked word

parts.note: devils are wicked beings

explanation.surface: Bad people beheaded, and the crimes they commit.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers back to the wicked folk: wrongs are what devils can do.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicked people are capable of wrongdoing and harm, which the plural noun names.

clue.text: Naturalist to attack feature of Genesis flood story, audibly

indicators.note: the two words are spoken aloud, giving the name

parts.words: attack feature of Genesis flood story
parts.note: to lam is to beat or attack; Noah's ark is the vessel in the flood of Genesis

explanation.surface: A naturalist sets out to demolish the Noah story.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Baptiste Lamarck was the French naturalist known for an early theory of evolution.

clue.text: Head of state in defeat creating stir

indicators.note: the leading letter goes inside the defeat word

parts.note: a rout is a heavy defeat

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter

explanation.surface: A head of state's defeat causes a stir.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head of state' looks like a leader, but just gives S.
explanation.definitionFit: To rouse someone or stir them into action, the verb means to disturb.

clue.text: Show home to fail as accommodation for pet

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: the failing word houses the pet within it

parts.note: to die is to fail, as an engine dies
a cat is a typical pet

explanation.surface: A show home falling short as lodging for a pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show home' reads as a model house, but 'Show' is the definition and 'home' gives IN.
explanation.definitionFit: To point out or signal something is to show it, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Africans only half loathe America

indicators.note: only the front half of the hating word is kept

parts.note: to loathe is to hate
USA stands for the United States of America

explanation.surface: Some Africans only partly dislike America.
explanation.definitionFit: A people of West Africa, mainly northern Nigeria and Niger, are called by this name.

clue.text: What the state sector is doing, providing residential areas

definitions.text: What the state sector is doing
definitions.meaning: the public sector provides homes for people, giving lodgings to the country's states, said whimsically
planned districts of homes built together

explanation.surface: Public authorities building homes for the people.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half reads the answer as a verb phrase: the state is housing, putting up, estates.
explanation.definitionFit: Planned developments of homes, often council-built, are the districts named here.
